name: Mirosław Lewandowski
bio:
Mirosław Lewandowski's career began not on the track, but in protecting assets. After a decade in private security, a chance encounter with a racing team owner at a charity event sparked his transition into motorsport. Initially handling logistics security for a smaller rally team, his meticulous approach and knack for identifying vulnerabilities quickly made him indispensable.

His move to Tolman Motorsport was a significant step up. Mirosław's approach to security is comprehensive, encompassing not only physical protection but also data integrity and intellectual property. He believes that a proactive, adaptable security posture is crucial in the high-stakes environment of motorsport. His calm demeanor and commitment to excellence have earned him the respect of the entire team.

What sets Mirosław apart is his quiet dedication. He's not one for grand pronouncements, but his subtle observations and proactive solutions consistently prevent problems before they arise. His dedication to maintaining a safe and secure environment allows the team to focus on what they do best: racing.

physical.description: He is of average height, with a sturdy build and watchful eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook and pen.
Insists on checking every door and window twice before leaving a room.
Has a habit of quietly humming Polish folk songs when deep in thought.
